cardDesc: Manage receivers registered on channel side
tip: Receivers must be bound on the channel side before receiving alloc funds; failed bindings are kept for retry after correction
name: Receiver Name
accountPlaceholder: Enter receiver account (openid is per selected app)
appOpenidTip: The account must be an openid under the selected app; a mismatch will fail the binding
bindTip: Re-initiate the channel-side binding; if the last failure was caused by a wrong app, change it here and retry
nameRequiredTip: Merchant full name is required for MERCHANT_ID
unbindConfirmContent: Unbind receiver {account}? After unbinding, funds can no longer be allocated to it. You can rebind to restore.
deleteConfirmContent: Delete receiver {account}? This only removes the local receiver record and does not affect the binding on the channel side.
validateSubApp: Sub-merchant app is required for PERSONAL_SUB_OPENID
scanFailed: Scan failed or expired, please try again

scanTip.wechat: Ask the receiver to scan with WeChat; the OpenId will be filled in automatically after web authorization
scanTip.alipay: Ask the receiver to scan with Alipay; the user ID will be filled in automatically after authorization
scanTip.douyin: Ask the receiver to scan with Douyin (the authorization page must be opened in the Douyin app); the OpenId will be filled in automatically after authorization
